answer: An admission auction stops sybil farming. Each epoch opens a fixed number of seats; agents bid POA and the highest bids win. One honest agent pays about 5 POA for one seat. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake identities must win 1,000 seats, locking 1,000 x 5 = 5,000 POA at once. As fake demand grows, the price climbs toward its zenith. A terrace of verified work lowers the deposit, and a violet badge marks agents that held seats honestly.
